title: Zep / Graphiti — where the paper and the code part ways
subtitle: Only the divergent steps are drawn. Each node states both sides; the lane says which stage of the pipeline the divergence sits in.
source: paper arXiv:2501.13956v1  ×  getzep/graphiti @ a6e026f  ×  servers/graphiti/server.py   ·   servers/graphiti/verification.md, 119 assertions checked (98 ✓ / 4 ✗ / 15 ◐ / 2 ?)
footer: memory-bench · methodology flow · paper ↔ code divergence
legend_notes: The headline: the paper's write path reads as a per-entity, per-edge LLM loop. The engine batches it. Entity resolution is one call, summaries go 30 at a time — cost is flat in the number of entities, not linear.
The single paper-only step is the reflexion self-check. It is the paper's stated defence against hallucinated entities, and the string 'reflexion' appears nowhere in the repo.
Everything the code added sits downstream: a fourth retrieval channel, a second auto-seeded BFS, a quota allocator and a hand-written χ — all in stages the paper leaves vague.
Two divergences are introduced by this repo's wrapper, not by the engine: session-sized episodes (D17) and the binary cross-encoder downgrade (D18).
